## The Hope Diamond’s Two-Day Journey by Mail

In 1958, jeweler Harry Winston donated the 45.5-carat Hope Diamond to the Smithsonian. On November 8, the gem was sent from New York’s General Post Office in a plain brown package by registered first-class mail.

The postage cost $2.44, and registration cost $142.85. The diamond reached the Smithsonian on November 10, in time for a presentation ceremony attended by Postmaster General Arthur Summerfield.
